description: Heart rate and blood pressure drop back to normal levels.
Carbon monoxide levels in your blood drop by half.
Carbon monoxide is eliminated. Lungs begin to clear out mucus.
Nicotine is out of the body. Sense of taste and smell improve.
Breathing becomes easier as bronchial tubes relax.
Circulation improves. Walking and exercising become easier.
Lung function increases by up to 30%.
Coughing and shortness of breath decrease significantly.
Risk of heart disease is half that of a smoker.
